title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Wellbeing/Sleep
description: Self-rated frequency of mood/wellbeing feelings, daytime napping, and total sleep duration, reported at the 3-year resurvey. All 7 fields are independent and available on every questionnaire version -- no skip patterns among them.

F1RELAX.title: Frequency of feeling relaxed
F1RELAX.$comment: Same 4-level shape as F1HAPPY, an independent question.

F1CONTRL.title: Frequency of feeling in control
F1CONTRL.$comment: Same 4-level shape as F1HAPPY, an independent question.

F1STRESS.title: Frequency of feeling stressed
F1STRESS.$comment: Same 4-level shape as F1HAPPY, an independent question.

F1TIRED.title: Frequency of feeling tired
F1TIRED.$comment: Same 4-level shape as F1HAPPY, an independent question.

F1NAP.title: Frequency of daytime naps
F1NAP.$comment: Only 3 levels (no 'Most of the time' option), unlike the 5 feeling-frequency fields above -- transcribed verbatim from the source's own code list.

F1SLEEP.title: Total sleep duration
F1SLEEP.$comment: Source states no valid range, but the field's own 'every 24 hours' framing structurally caps it at 24 -- not a stated D/E bound, but a structural fact rather than a guess, same reasoning as F1ALCDAY's 7-day cap (D061). Type number since sleep duration can be fractional (e.g. 7.5 hours). The source's own 99 code is kept as its own const branch, not merged into missing_numeric, same treatment as F1MENOAG's 77/99 (D051).
